name: Combat Warriors
desc:
A bloody and gory melee & ranged weapon fighting game.

Premium users have access to Premium AFK Rewards by clicking the button with the Premium icon found on the bottom left of the main menu

2x XP + chance for Daily Spins from kills every Friday, Saturday, and Sunday

Type "/psCmds" in chat to view all Private Server commands | Pressing ";" opens the command bar

Buy our UGC with our in-game menu for exclusive in-game rewards (Buying the UGC through the website/app will not grant you the in-game rewards)
The UGC menu is located next to the "Customize" button
